entries.title: Exodus 15:1
segments: Those dispensations of Providence which excite our greatest fears, often so result as to call forth our loudest praises.

entries.title: Exodus 15:2
segments: A habitation; a place for his public worship.

entries.title: Exodus 15:7
segments: They that, being often reproved, continue to harden their hearts, will be suddenly destroyed, and that without remedy.

entries.title: Exodus 15:8
segments: Blast of thy nostrils; the wind which made the sea go back,
, here represented as the breath of the Almighty.
The depths were congealed; made to stand upon either side like walls of ice.

entries.title: Exodus 15:10
segments:
Didst blow with thy wind; a wind opposite to that which made the sea retire, and which hastened its return to overwhelm the Egyptians. 
 
When the enemies of God are most confident of success, they are often the nearest to destruction.

entries.title: Exodus 15:12
segments: The earth; the sea in the depths of the earth.

entries.title: Exodus 15:13
segments: Thy holy habitation; the land of Canaan, where God would delight to dwell with his people.  But perhaps here, and
, there is a prophetic allusion to mount Zion, which became God's special dwelling-place.

entries.title: Exodus 15:14
segments: Palestina; that is, the country of the Philistines.  See note,

entries.title: Exodus 15:15
segments: Dukes; leaders, princes.

entries.title: Exodus 15:16
segments:
Pass over; over the desert and through the intervening countries, to take possession of Canaan. 
 
  Purchased; redeemed or delivered from bondage, to be his peculiar people. 
 
That fear of coming evil which prevents exertion and leads to despair, instead of delivering from danger, only increases it, and prevents escape.

entries.title: Exodus 15:17
segments: The mountain of thine inheritance; the land of Canaan, especially Zion, and the temple where he would dwell.  See note,

entries.title: Exodus 15:20
segments: The prophetess; appointed of God to instruct the women, and lead them in their devotions.

. 
 
  Timbrel; a musical instrument like the tambourine.

entries.title: Exodus 15:21
segments:
Miriam answered; she led the women, who sung responsively with the men. 
 
Great deliverances should be celebrated with manifestations of hearty gratitude to God, and sincere devotion of body and soul to his service.

entries.title: Exodus 15:23
segments: Marah; meaning bitterness; where was a fountain of bitter water.

entries.title: Exodus 15:25
segments: Statute--ordinance; rule, direction, or decree, mentioned

. 
 
  Proved them; tried them by his providence, and thus gave them opportunity to show whether they would obey him.

entries.title: Exodus 15:26
segments: Healeth thee; removes all plagues, sicknesses, and infirmities, such as those which they had witnessed in Egypt.  These are always regarded in the holy Scriptures as chastisements for sin.  See

.  The outward healing of the body is a symbol of the more glorious healing and sanctifying of the soul by God's grace. 
 
The human heart cannot be safely trusted.  At one time it will sing praises to God, and at another murmur against him.  All true confidence in God, and all genuine love to him, are the fruit of his Spirit; and to him belongs the glory of every thing spiritually good in men.

entries.title: Exodus 15:27
segments: Elim; a place south-east of Marah, and on the way to mount Sinai.
